context: A police officer briefs a uni reporter about a courthouse story
purpose: Teach: 公判/判事/ノーベル/飼育/曲線/半数/根底/療養

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 今日の初公判の件で来てもらったんだ。記者証は持ってきたかい？
lines.en: I called you in about today's first hearing. Did you bring your press pass?
lines.style: Calm, professional officer briefing a young reporter with measured authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ちゃんと持ってきました。担当の判事はどなたになるんですか？
lines.en: Yes, I brought it with me. Who will be the presiding judge on this?
lines.style: Eager university student speaking politely with notebook in hand, slightly nervous.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 山下判事だ。経歴は長くて、確かノーベル賞候補の研究者の遺産訴訟も扱ったことがある。
lines.en: Judge Yamashita. He's experienced, and once handled an inheritance suit involving a Nobel candidate.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact officer sharing background detail with quiet confidence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: へえ、すごい方なんですね。今回の事件って、動物の飼育施設が関係してるって本当ですか？
lines.en: Wow, that's impressive. Is it true this case involves an animal breeding facility?
lines.style: Curious student leaning forward, genuinely interested and asking follow-up questions.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: そうだ。経営状態は悪化の一途で、業績の曲線を見れば一目瞭然だった。被害者は半数以上が高齢者でね。
lines.en: Correct. The business was sinking — the revenue curve made that obvious. Over half the victims were elderly.
lines.style: Officer speaking factually but with a hint of weariness about the case.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 半数以上ですか…根底にあるのは経営者の倫理観の欠如ってことでしょうか。
lines.en: More than half? So fundamentally, this comes down to the owner's lack of ethics?
lines.style: Reporter pressing thoughtfully, trying to grasp the deeper angle of the story.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 君の見立てはまっとうだよ。ただ書く時は慎重に。被告は今、自宅療養中だ。
lines.en: Your read on it is sound. But write carefully — the defendant is currently recuperating at home.
lines.style: Officer offering a gentle but firm warning, mentoring tone toward the young reporter.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。療養中だという点も配慮して、丁寧にまとめます。ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Understood. I'll factor in his recovery and write it carefully. Thank you very much.
lines.style: Respectful student bowing slightly, grateful for the guidance and trust.
